title: rust-toolchain.toml pins the stable channel so release containers meet rust-version
decision: Add rust-toolchain.toml with channel = "stable" at the repo root. The aarch64-pc-windows-msvc release job runs inside messense/cargo-xwin (FROM rust:1.89.0) and the generated workflow skips installing Rust when cargo exists, so rustc 1.89 rejected tirith-mcp 1.0.0 (rust-version 1.90). rustup reads the file in the container and installs current stable; dist adds the cross target itself. ADR-0023.
rationale: Cannot lower rust-version (tray crates need 1.90); the container pin is outside our control; dist's rust-toolchain-version option is deprecated in favour of this file; github-build-setup would add hand-written YAML for something rustup does on its own. Pinning an exact version would force every developer's rustup to download it.
alternatives: github-build-setup step running rustup update when matrix.container is set
